translated_title: Senate Approves Digital Payments Law; Finance Secretariat Will Be Able to Define Where They Will Be Mandatory
original_title: Senado aprueba ley de pagos digitales; Hacienda podrá definir dónde serán obligatorios
author: Andrea Becerril and Georgina Saldierna
meta_description: Cash is not being phased out across the board, but even Morena senator Ricardo Sheffield voted no, warning an unelected technocrat would decide where it is banned.
